# Arm CMSIS-Core

Unmodified files from [CMSIS 6.3.0](https://github.com/ARM-software/CMSIS_6/releases/tag/v6.3.0)
(commit `d45851523a78b572c9e8ccf2afe498f2630a3a82`), copied from its `CMSIS/`
folder with the same layout below this one.

Only the Cortex-M headers the boards in this repository include are here.
They are Apache-2.0; see [LICENSE](LICENSE), CMSIS's own license file.

## Updating

1. Download the new release from <https://github.com/ARM-software/CMSIS_6/releases>.
2. Copy over each file here from the same path under the release's `CMSIS/`,
   plus `LICENSE` from the release's top folder.
3. Update the version and commit above and rebuild the boards.
